# Francis Naga

> Personal portfolio and systems engineering showcase of Efobi Francis Chibundo (Francis Naga), software developer and marine engineering student based in Nigeria. Building focused digital products across web, mobile, and document automation.

## Verified Flagship Projects
- [Jetty Campus Marketplace](https://jetty.francisnaga.site): Campus marketplace, student housing directory, and service booking platform built for Nigeria Maritime University students (Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase).
- [Inkto Android App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.inkto.app): Native Android document scanning and audio transcription utility built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room DB, and ML Kit OCR.
- [CemGuard Industrial IoT](https://github.com/francisnaga/CemGuard): Predictive maintenance and reliability decision-support platform linking physics-engine digital twins to live sensor telemetry (Next.js 15, TypeScript, Recharts, Zustand).

## Secondary Projects
- [Recall](https://github.com/BuildItt-Inc/definam-pwa): Offline-first learning and engineering exam revision platform with active recall study decks (FastAPI, Python, Next.js PWA).
- [InvoiceFlow (NCB)](https://github.com/francisnaga/INVOICEFLOW): Automated invoicing suite with Paystack integration and instant WhatsApp invoice delivery.
- [CivicTrack](https://github.com/francisnaga): Smart municipal complaint and issue reporting platform with geotagged infrastructure tracking.
- [Metamask Simulator](https://github.com/francisnaga/Metamask-Simulator): Mobile-first Web3 crypto wallet simulator with ERC-20 sandbox.
- [Coursemate](https://github.com/francisnaga/Coursemate): Engineering syllabus and lecture note companion for NMU students.
